methods.name: DTF (direct to film)
methods.description: Design is printed on film and heat-pressed on. Works on most fabrics and any color, dark ones too.

methods.name: Dye sublimation
methods.description: Ink dyes right into the surface, so it never cracks or peels and you can't feel it. Needs polyester in white or light colors.

materialOptions.name: Polyester
materialOptions.description: Lightweight, dries fast, holds its shape. Needed for sublimation.
